#!/bin/bash
# vim: softtabstop=2 shiftwidth=2 expandtab

# zluks: manage LUKS volumes from the ZFSBootMenu recovery shell or over SSH

sources=(
  /lib/profiling-lib.sh
  /etc/zfsbootmenu.conf
  /lib/kmsg-log-lib.sh
  /lib/zfsbootmenu-core.sh
  /lib/zfsbootmenu-luks.sh
)

for src in "${sources[@]}"; do
  # shellcheck disable=SC1090
  if ! source "${src}" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "ERROR: unable to source ${src}" >&2
    exit 1
  fi
done

unset src sources

usage() {
  cat <<-USAGE
	Usage: ${0##*/} [command]

	Commands:
	  unlock               Unlock all configured LUKS volumes (default)
	  open <device> [name] Unlock a single LUKS volume; device may be a path or
	                       UUID=, PARTUUID=, LABEL=, PARTLABEL=, ID=, PATH=
	  close [name]         Export pools on, and close, mappings opened by
	                       ZFSBootMenu (all of them unless a name is given)
	  status               List mappings opened by ZFSBootMenu
	  list                 List all LUKS volumes on the system and their
	                       LUKS2 tokens (TPM2, FIDO2, clevis)

	After unlocking, return to ZFSBootMenu (type 'exit') to import pools, or
	run 'zpool import' manually.
	USAGE
}

if ! luks_available; then
  echo "ERROR: cryptsetup is not available in this image" >&2
  exit 1
fi

cmd="${1:-unlock}"
[ "$#" -gt 0 ] && shift

case "${cmd}" in
  unlock)
    luks_unlock_all
    ;;
  open)
    if [ -z "${1}" ]; then
      usage >&2
      exit 1
    fi

    if ! dev="$( luks_resolve_device "${1}" )"; then
      echo "ERROR: device '${1}' not found" >&2
      exit 1
    fi

    luks_open_device "${2}" "${dev}" "$( get_zbm_arg zbm.luks_key )" "" ""
    ret=$?
    luks_forget_secrets
    udevadm settle >/dev/null 2>&1
    exit "${ret}"
    ;;
  close)
    luks_close_all "${1}"
    ;;
  status)
    if [ ! -s "${LUKS_STATE}" ]; then
      echo "No LUKS mappings opened by ZFSBootMenu"
      exit 0
    fi

    while IFS=$'\t' read -r name dev _; do
      [ -n "${name}" ] || continue
      if [ -b "/dev/mapper/${name}" ]; then
        state="$( colorize green "open" )"
        pools="$( luks_pools_on_device "/dev/mapper/${name}" | tr '\n' ' ' )"
      else
        state="$( colorize red "closed" )"
        pools=""
      fi
      echo -e "${name}\t${dev}\t${state}${pools:+\tpools: ${pools}}"
    done < "${LUKS_STATE}"
    ;;
  list)
    while read -r dev; do
      [ -n "${dev}" ] || continue
      if luks_is_open "${dev}"; then
        state="$( colorize green "in use" )"
      else
        state="$( colorize yellow "locked" )"
      fi
      tokens="$( luks_list_tokens "${dev}" | awk '{ print $2 }' | sort -u | tr '\n' ' ' )"
      echo -e "$( luks_describe_device "${dev}" )\t${state}${tokens:+\ttokens: ${tokens}}"
    done <<< "$( luks_discover_devices )"
    ;;
  -h|--help|help)
    usage
    ;;
  *)
    usage >&2
    exit 1
    ;;
esac

#!/bin/bash
# vim: softtabstop=2 shiftwidth=2 expandtab

## This early-setup hook attempts to get a physical (non-serial) console
## to at least 110 columns.

#shellcheck disable=SC1091
source /lib/zfsbootmenu-kcl.sh || exit 1
source /lib/kmsg-log-lib.sh || exit 1

if [ -z "${control_term}" ] && [ -f /etc/zfsbootmenu.conf ]; then
  #shellcheck disable=SC1091
  source /etc/zfsbootmenu.conf
fi

# Control terminal MUST be defined to proceed
[ -c "${control_term}" ] || exit 1

# Ensure that control_term is not a serial console
tty_re='/dev/tty[0-9]'
[[ ${control_term} =~ ${tty_re} ]] || exit 1

# Respect custom fonts set by the 'consolefont' mkinitcpio module
if [ -e /consolefont.psfu ] || [ -e /consolefont.psf ]; then
  exit 1
fi

# rd.vconsole.font is consumed by the Dracut i18n module, which is forced to run before this hook
# If the user has specified a specific font/size, do not attempt to override it

if get_zbm_bool 1 zbm.autosize && ! font=$( get_zbm_arg rd.vconsole.font ) ; then
  for font in /usr/share/zfsbootmenu/fonts/ter-v{{32,28,24,20,14}b,12n}.psf ; do
    [ -f "${font}" ] || continue
    setfont "${font}" >/dev/null 2>&1 || continue

    # 110 columns is the current minimum to show both the sort key and a note on the snapshot screen
    if [ "${COLUMNS}" -ge 110 ]; then
      zinfo "font set to ${font}, ${control_term} is ${COLUMNS}x${LINES}"
      break
    fi
  done
fi

#!/bin/bash
# vim: softtabstop=2 shiftwidth=2 expandtab

## Close the LUKS mappings that ZFSBootMenu opened to import ZFS pools.
##
## The boot environment's own initramfs must unlock its LUKS volumes again
## after kexec, so nothing is lost here. Exporting the affected pools and
## closing the mappings guarantees a clean hand-off and makes the kernel wipe
## the dm-crypt volume keys from memory before the new kernel starts.
##
## This hook may be disabled with zbm.skip_hooks=80-luks-close.sh

sources=(
  /lib/profiling-lib.sh
  /etc/zfsbootmenu.conf
  /lib/kmsg-log-lib.sh
  /lib/zfsbootmenu-core.sh
  /lib/zfsbootmenu-luks.sh
)

for src in "${sources[@]}"; do
  # shellcheck disable=SC1090
  source "${src}" >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0
done

unset src sources

luks_close_all
exit 0

#!/bin/bash
## Shadow mode: compare the legacy runtime's decisions for this boot with
## the Rust code's and print the differences and a summary line. It only
## reads and never stops the boot.
##
## This hook may be disabled with zbm.skip_hooks=99-zbm-shadow.sh

/libexec/zbm shadow
exit 0

#!/bin/bash
## Size the console font to the display (zbm.autosize), with zbm: from the
## display's physical size where its EDID gives it, so that text is readable
## on high-density (HiDPI) and ordinary screens alike.
##
## This hook may be disabled with zbm.skip_hooks=30-console-autosize.sh

exec /libexec/zbm console-autosize

#!/bin/bash
## Close the LUKS mappings that ZFSBootMenu opened to import ZFS pools, with
## zluks: the pools on them are exported first, and closing them makes the
## kernel wipe the dm-crypt volume keys before the new kernel starts.
##
## This hook may be disabled with zbm.skip_hooks=80-luks-close.sh

command -v cryptsetup >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0
/bin/zluks close
exit 0
